questions.question: Manish starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards East. He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 30 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 20 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 18 km and stops at Point Q. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he now drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only.)
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Manish starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards East.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b3a8ab5cdef8111684d57002371d58da1133dcda384932a074c4533d9bbb662.png] 

2) He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 30 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28a6e392602e55168289fff21b592b4b01f3b7307ede6415f04e015501f93c6e.png] 

3) He then takes a left turn and drives 20 km. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62b85f4f2dac2fa6857206592dd25ed1de86d2c035567e50a13a8a4c902de55e.png] 

4) He takes a final left turn, drives 18 km and stops at Point Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e439904fa5a86bb08af741eb1e5e835b7d7f3eb402f59e7d674d331fd6132ba.png] 

The shortest distance between point Q and A = 20 - 5 = 15 km

Here, we can see that Manish need to drive 15 km towards North to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****15 km towards North"**.

If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘–’, what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

70 D 11 B 5 C 45 A 9 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 70 D 11 B 5 C 45 A 9 = ? 

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 70 - 11 × 5 + **45 ÷ 9** = ? 

⇒ 70 - **11 ****×**** 5** + 5 = ? 

⇒ **70** - 55 **+ 5 **= ? 

⇒ **75 - 55** = **20**

Hence, the correct option is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pineapples are papayas.

All papayas are pears.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pineapples are pears.

II. Some pears are pineapples.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d093eb3a5c1d67160e5baf797e4fb53e5f06493dc29fe01cdb0cebd9819fc292.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pineapples are pears → **True** (All pineapples are papayas, and all papayas are pears implies that all pineapples are pears).

II. Some pears are pineapples → **True** (All pineapples are papayas, and all papayas are pears implies that some part of pears which are papayas are also pineapples).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow"**.
